channel.title: Houston Public Media - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Houston Public Media (houstonpublicmedia.org)

item.title: Abbott breaks with Trump over president’s call to nationalize elections
item.description: The Texas governor pushed back against the president’s call for federal oversight, even as Abbott and other Republicans have taken steps to assert state control over Harris County elections.

item.title: Here’s who will be on March primary ballots in the Houston area
item.description: With the candidate filing deadline having passed this week, Houston Public Media has a rundown of the Democratic and Republican hopefuls for notable county-level races as well as races for Houston-area seats in Congress.

item.title: Colony Ridge developers will pay $68 million, halt construction to settle predatory lending lawsuit with DOJ
item.description: The agreement with the Department of Justice and U.S. Consumer Financial Protection Bureau, filed in court Tuesday, settles the 2023 lawsuit alleging that owners of the development engaged in deceptive advertising and targeted Hispanic residents with predatory loans and seller-financed mortgages.

item.title: Galveston County jury awards $60 million against Friendswood mother and son after 2023 fatal shooting
item.description: Connor Hilton, 19, was sentenced to 50 years in prison as part of a plea bargain for the fatal 2023 shooting of his friend, Ethan Riley. Hilton's mother, Johnece, was found to be grossly negligent in a civil case for allowing her son to have access to the gun.

item.title: Hello Houston (February 10, 2026)
item.description: Today: We discuss the Trump administration asking states to turn over their voter rolls, talk with one of the stars of “Real Women Have Curves,” learn about the HALT Drunk Driving Law, and more.

item.title: City of La Marque announces Byron Frankland as new chief of police
item.description: Byron Frankland, who currently serves as the emergency operations manager for the City of Galveston, will start the new job on Jan 16. City officials said there will be a meet and greet with the new police chief soon.

item.title: Hello Houston – The Commuter Cut (February 10, 2026)
item.description: For our busy Houston commuters – we have “The Commuter Cut” – a special 40-minute version of our show to listen to during your journey home.

item.title: Cy-Fair ISD board votes to reinstate removed textbook chapters
item.description: The specific lessons and topics addressed in the chapters include climate change, vaccinations, cultural diversity, depopulation and humans' impact on the Earth and its ecosystems.

item.title: ERCOT to update planning process for connecting data centers, other large loads to Texas power grid
item.description: The state's grid operator plans to evaluate its transmission capacity for new data centers in batches.

item.title: Houston ISD students join statewide walkouts protesting ICE amid threat of school penalties
item.description: While chanting “ICE off our streets, ICE off our streets,” several students said they were there to call attention to the treatment of immigrants under the Trump Administration.
